name: EraLend SyncSwap LP oracle read-only reentrancy
summary: EraLend's price oracle 0xa6380073c0a1472943c866eacc763864fea8d1cc values the eUSDC/WETH cSLP market's SyncSwap USDC/WETH LP token as (reserve0 * price0 + reserve1 * price1) / totalSupply, read live from pool 0x80115c708e12edd42e504c1cd52aea96c547c05c with no reentrancy check. Inside SyncSwap's burn callback the LP supply is already reduced while the stored reserves are not yet updated, so the attacker's contracts re-entered EraLend from syncSwapBaseBurnCallback, had the LP collateral valued about 46% above its true price, and borrowed 3,435,724.597462 USDC from eUSDC over two transactions.

loss.notes: Exact net USDC (bridged USDC 0x3355df6d4c9c3035724fd0e3914de96a5a83aaf4, 6 decimals) Transfer outflow of eUSDC 0x1181d7be04d80a8ae096641ee1a87f7d557c6aeb: 2,110,580.038872 in 0x99efebac (block 9501652) and 1,325,144.558590 in 0x7ac4da1e (block 9501802). No other EraLend market has a net outflow in either receipt. The attacker left 0.002793596182148684 + 0.001718134742762619 LP tokens as eLP collateral (about 0.0045 LP, roughly 431k USD at the pre-attack oracle price of 95,464,557 USD per LP); this attacker-supplied collateral is not deducted from gross victim depletion. The attacker EOA received 1,722,698.758092 + 1,040,481.212287 USDC; the rest repaid its swap-based flash liquidity. rekt.news reports 3.4M USD total loss.

ageReset.description: The comptroller admin's _setMintPaused(eLP, false) opened the eUSDC/WETH cSLP market 0x00a1c271df375660f47293fd84b53572fded0107 to deposits: Unitroller.mintGuardianPaused(eLP) changes from true to false at the block boundary (ActionPaused log 60). Minting had been paused since block 6534311, right after listing, so no LP collateral priced by this oracle could be created before; the oracle, its selection by the comptroller (block 6527291), the listing (6527370) and the nonzero collateral factor (6608591) all precede this change, and no later pause, oracle, listing or collateral-factor change for eLP occurs before the exploit.

limitations: Curve admission is blocked only by the mechanical code-hash anchor: zkSync Era RPCs implement debug_traceTransaction with callTracer/flatCallTracer only (prestateTracer rejected), and the exploit is transaction index 10, so scripts/verify.mjs reports target-1:code-hash INCONCLUSIVE. Manual evidence: eth_getCode hashes to the declared codeHash at blocks 6524035 and 9501651, and callTracer traces of block 9501652 transactions 0-9 (0x4050ee88 through 0x53d21957) contain no call to the oracle and no ContractDeployer 0x8006 create/create2/createAccount/create2Account/forceDeployOnAddresses call. Promote to reviewed and curveEligible once the verifier accepts that proof or a prestate-capable zkSync provider is available.

The oracle's source is unverified on the zkSync explorer; its pricing formula is established from the exploit call trace and by reproducing its pre-attack getUnderlyingPrice(eLP) output from pool reserves, LP supply and the oracle's own USDC and WETH prices.

sources.note: Target: oracle 0xa6380073c0a1472943c866eacc763864fea8d1cc was created by EraLend deployer 0x144706c149123732e9496792d8d44f9f338b67e8 through ContractDeployer 0x8006 in 0x4b9874b7 (block 6524035:0, ts 1687247026). eth_getCode is empty at 6524034 and hashes to 0xb6d2d89fd09992e5d4aba14d3bc903e66740fe722833eebb77661f3086da665a (28,960 bytes) at 6524035 and 9501651; the oracle emitted no logs in 6524035-9501652. Its only configuration calls are updatePythPriceIds (0x243e5f57) in 6524039 and 6524819, 0xdf9f7fd4(pool 0x80115c70, true) in 6524043 and updateAdmin(0x9eee479dcf6075a0cb905c27e8f952910c3bb69d) in 6524046 (explorer txlists of 0x144706 and 0x9eee through 9501652). Unitroller 0x0171ca5b372eb510245f5fa214f5582911934b3d eth_getLogs through 9501652: NewPriceOracle to this oracle at 6527291:12 log 64 (only change after 71730); MarketListed(eLP 0x00a1c271df375660f47293fd84b53572fded0107) at 6527370:1 log 4; NewCollateralFactor(eLP) 0 -> 0.7e18 at 6608591:16 log 91 and 0.7e18 -> 0.6e18 at 6612479:9 log 58; ActionPaused(eLP) Mint true at 6534311:5 log 34 and Mint false at 7114172:8 log 60 (other eLP ActionPaused logs are Borrow toggles, irrelevant because the attacker borrows USDC); NewImplementation last at 1930738. eth_call mintGuardianPaused(eLP) (calldata 0x731f0c2b...) returns 1 at 7114171 and 0 at 7114172 and 9501651 (public RPC https://mainnet.era.zksync.io; the l2beat endpoint rejects historical eth_call without gas). Later _setMarketSupplyCaps(eLP) raises (7068730: 3.1559577282140163e16; 8562320: 5.1559577282140163e16 LP-wei) only bound exposure: eLP underlying was 2.8841e16 at 8562319 and 4.4316e16 at 9501651, leaving headroom under either cap. Age = 1690277085 - 1687844398 = 2,432,687 s (vs 3,030,059 s from deployment). Pricing reproduced at block 9501651: pool getReserves = 29,686,996.467806 USDC and 16,035.389010407710954902 WETH, totalSupply 0.622676888656844893 LP, oracle prices 1.000013 USD (eUSDC) and 1,855.66005478 USD (eWETH 0x1bbd3338) give 95,464,621 USD per LP versus getUnderlyingPrice(eLP) = 95,464,557.076797e18 (1e-6 relative).

Anchor: EOA 0xf1d076c9be4533086f967e14ee6aff204d5ece7a called start() (0xbe9a6555) on its contract 0x7d8772dce73cda0332bc47451ab868ac98f335f0 in 0x99efebac (block 9501652:10, ts 1690277085, status 1, 652 logs). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): nested flash swaps (uniswapV2Call/hook/muteswitchCall callbacks) fund USDC and WETH; the contract mints pool LP, calls eLP.mint, then pool.burn(bytes,address,address,bytes) (0xf66eab5b), and from syncSwapBaseBurnCallback (0x84f513e8) enters markets and calls eUSDC.borrow. The 32 oracle getUnderlyingPrice(eLP) reads inside burn frames return 138,974,411.718e18 per LP; the 144 reads inside pool.mint frames return 65,576,687.788e18; pre-attack value 95,464,557.077e18 at 9501651. Second leg 0x7ac4da1e (9501802:6, ts 1690277241, attacker contract 0xc5c668dcd437b901dfe877dc99329ac2ba338035) repeats the same call pattern (658 logs). Loss from receipts: net Transfer of USDC 0x3355df6d from eUSDC 0x1181d7be04d80a8ae096641ee1a87f7d557c6aeb is -2,110,580.038872 and -1,325,144.558590; the EOA nets +1,722,698.758092 and +1,040,481.212287 USDC. Earliest-exercise scan: the exploit needs an eLP Mint and a pool Burn in one transaction; eth_getLogs over 7114172-9501652 (eLP Mint(address,uint256,uint256) 86,265 txs, pool Burn topic 0xd175a80c 172,492 txs, 10k-100k block chunks) intersect only in 0x99efebac, and minting was paused before 7114172. Over 9501653-9700000 the only intersection is 0x7ac4da1e; mintGuardianPaused(eLP) is true again by block 9510000. The attacker's 84 non-deploy txs from 9398126 contain no other receipt touching eLP or eUSDC. rekt.news attributes the incident to this read-only reentrancy and lists both hashes.
